phoneticConvention: Approximate respelling for English readers (CAPITALS = stressed syllable; vowels ah / eh / ee / oh / oo; c+e/i → ch, g+e/i → j, gn → ny, gl → ly, sc+e/i → sh, z → ts / dz; double consonants held longer, e.g. kaf-FEH). No substitute for the audio.
reviewStatus: Written by rule from validated content; native English review recommended.
title: Asking and negotiating
goal: Ask politely, express a condition and negotiate simply.

variants.study: Potrebbe farmi uno sconto, per favore?
variants.phon: poh-TREHB-beh FAR-mee OO-noh SKOHN-toh, pehr fah-VOH-reh
variants.native: Could you give me a discount, please?

variants.study: Potrebbe aspettare un momento, per favore?
variants.phon: poh-TREHB-beh ahs-peht-TAH-reh oon moh-MEHN-toh, pehr fah-VOH-reh
variants.native: Could you wait a moment, please?

variants.study: Potrebbe richiamarmi domani, per favore?
variants.phon: poh-TREHB-beh ree-kyah-MAR-mee doh-MAH-nee, pehr fah-VOH-reh
variants.native: Could you call me back tomorrow, please?

variants.study: Potrebbe controllare la prenotazione, per favore?
variants.phon: poh-TREHB-beh kohn-trohl-LAH-reh lah preh-noh-tah-TSYOH-neh, pehr fah-VOH-reh
variants.native: Could you check the booking, please?

variants.study: Potrei pagare con la carta?
variants.phon: poh-TREH-ee pah-GAH-reh kohn lah KAR-tah
variants.native: Could I pay by card?

variants.study: Potrei avere una ricevuta?
variants.phon: poh-TREH-ee ah-VEH-reh OO-nah ree-cheh-VOO-tah
variants.native: Could I have a receipt?

variants.study: Potrei cambiare la data?
variants.phon: poh-TREH-ee kahm-BYAH-reh lah DAH-tah
variants.native: Could I change the date?

variants.study: Potrei parlare con il responsabile?
variants.phon: poh-TREH-ee par-LAH-reh kohn eel rehs-pohn-SAH-bee-leh
variants.native: Could I speak to the manager?

variants.study: Se mi fa uno sconto, pagherò subito.
variants.phon: seh mee fah OO-noh SKOHN-toh, pah-geh-ROH SOO-bee-toh
variants.native: If you give me a discount, I'll pay right away.

variants.study: Se è possibile, pagherò subito.
variants.phon: seh eh pohs-SEE-bee-leh, pah-geh-ROH SOO-bee-toh
variants.native: If it's possible, I'll pay right away.

variants.study: Se accetta la carta, pagherò subito.
variants.phon: seh aht-CHEHT-tah lah KAR-tah, pah-geh-ROH SOO-bee-toh
variants.native: If you take cards, I'll pay right away.

variants.study: Se il prezzo è giusto, pagherò subito.
variants.phon: seh eel PREHT-tsoh eh JOOS-toh, pah-geh-ROH SOO-bee-toh
variants.native: If the price is right, I'll pay right away.

variants.study: Sarebbe possibile avere una camera più grande?
variants.phon: sah-REHB-beh pohs-SEE-bee-leh ah-VEH-reh OO-nah KAH-meh-rah pyoo GRAHN-deh
variants.native: Would it be possible to have a bigger room?

variants.study: Sarebbe possibile pagare domani?
variants.phon: sah-REHB-beh pohs-SEE-bee-leh pah-GAH-reh doh-MAH-nee
variants.native: Would it be possible to pay tomorrow?

variants.study: Sarebbe possibile cambiare il volo?
variants.phon: sah-REHB-beh pohs-SEE-bee-leh kahm-BYAH-reh eel VOH-loh
variants.native: Would it be possible to change the flight?

variants.study: Sarebbe possibile spostare l'appuntamento?
variants.phon: sah-REHB-beh pohs-SEE-bee-leh spohs-TAH-reh lahp-poon-tah-MEHN-toh
variants.native: Would it be possible to move the appointment?

variants.study: Va bene, ma solo se paga subito.
variants.phon: vah BEH-neh, mah SOH-loh seh PAH-gah SOO-bee-toh
variants.native: All right, but only if you pay right away.

variants.study: Va bene, ma solo se finiamo entro venerdì.
variants.phon: vah BEH-neh, mah SOH-loh seh fee-NYAH-moh EHN-troh veh-nehr-DEE
variants.native: All right, but only if we finish by Friday.

variants.study: Va bene, ma solo se il prezzo non cambia.
variants.phon: vah BEH-neh, mah SOH-loh seh eel PREHT-tsoh nohn KAHM-byah
variants.native: All right, but only if the price doesn't change.

variants.study: Va bene, ma solo se mi chiama prima.
variants.phon: vah BEH-neh, mah SOH-loh seh mee KYAH-mah PREE-mah
variants.native: All right, but only if you call me first.

units.situation: Apologising and making up for it

model.note: "Mi dispiace" is the same whoever is speaking. "La richiamerò" is the formal "Lei" form.

variants.study: Mi dispiace, lo farò subito.
variants.phon: mee dees-PYAH-cheh, loh fah-ROH SOO-bee-toh
variants.native: I'm sorry, I'll do it right away.

variants.study: Mi dispiace, La richiamerò domani.
variants.phon: mee dees-PYAH-cheh, lah ree-kyah-meh-ROH doh-MAH-nee
variants.native: I'm sorry, I'll call you back tomorrow.

slot.native: I'll be there in ten minutes

variants.study: Mi dispiace, arriverò tra dieci minuti.
variants.phon: mee dees-PYAH-cheh, ar-ree-veh-ROH trah DYEH-chee mee-NOO-tee
variants.native: I'm sorry, I'll be there in ten minutes.

variants.study: Mi dispiace, non succederà più.
variants.phon: mee dees-PYAH-cheh, nohn soot-cheh-deh-RAH PYOO
variants.native: I'm sorry, it won't happen again.

units.situation: Asking for a discount or a document

variants.study: Mi può fare uno sconto?
variants.phon: mee pwoh FAH-reh OO-noh SKOHN-toh
variants.native: Could you give me a discount?

variants.study: Mi può fare un prezzo migliore?
variants.phon: mee pwoh FAH-reh oon PREHT-tsoh mee-LYOH-reh
variants.native: Could you give me a better price?

variants.study: Mi può fare una fattura?
variants.phon: mee pwoh FAH-reh OO-nah faht-TOO-rah
variants.native: Could you give me an invoice?

variants.study: Mi può fare una copia?
variants.phon: mee pwoh FAH-reh OO-nah KOH-pyah
variants.native: Could you give me a copy?

variants.study: Avrei bisogno di più tempo.
variants.phon: ah-VREH-ee bee-ZOH-nyoh dee pyoo TEHM-poh
variants.native: I'd need more time.

variants.study: Avrei bisogno di qualche giorno in più.
variants.phon: ah-VREH-ee bee-ZOH-nyoh dee KWAHL-keh JOR-noh een PYOO
variants.native: I'd need a few more days.

variants.study: Avrei bisogno di una risposta entro domani.
variants.phon: ah-VREH-ee bee-ZOH-nyoh dee OO-nah rees-POHS-tah EHN-troh doh-MAH-nee
variants.native: I'd need an answer by tomorrow.

variants.study: Avrei bisogno di un altro appuntamento.
variants.phon: ah-VREH-ee bee-ZOH-nyoh dee oon AHL-troh ahp-poon-tah-MEHN-toh
variants.native: I'd need another appointment.

variants.study: Purtroppo non posso, ho già un impegno.
variants.phon: poor-TROHP-poh nohn POHS-soh, oh JAH oon eem-PEH-nyoh
variants.native: Unfortunately I can't, I already have a commitment.

variants.study: Purtroppo non posso, è troppo caro per me.
variants.phon: poor-TROHP-poh nohn POHS-soh, eh TROHP-poh KAH-roh pehr MEH
variants.native: Unfortunately I can't, it's too expensive for me.

slot.native: I don't have time this week

variants.study: Purtroppo non posso, non ho tempo questa settimana.
variants.phon: poor-TROHP-poh nohn POHS-soh, nohn oh TEHM-poh KWEHS-tah seht-tee-MAH-nah
variants.native: Unfortunately I can't, I don't have time this week.

slot.native: I have to ask my wife

variants.study: Purtroppo non posso, devo chiedere a mia moglie.
variants.phon: poor-TROHP-poh nohn POHS-soh, DEH-voh KYEH-deh-reh ah MEE-ah MOH-lyeh
variants.native: Unfortunately I can't, I have to ask my wife.

units.situation: Neighbours: asking if it's a problem

variants.study: Le dispiace se apro la finestra?
variants.phon: leh dees-PYAH-cheh seh AH-proh lah fee-NEHS-trah
variants.native: Do you mind if I open the window?

slot.native: I have a party on Saturday

variants.study: Le dispiace se faccio una festa sabato?
variants.phon: leh dees-PYAH-cheh seh FAHT-choh OO-nah FEHS-tah SAH-bah-toh
variants.native: Do you mind if I have a party on Saturday?

variants.study: Le dispiace se parcheggio qui?
variants.phon: leh dees-PYAH-cheh seh par-KEHD-joh KWEE
variants.native: Do you mind if I park here?

variants.study: Le dispiace se lascio la bici qui?

variants.native: Do you mind if I leave my bike here?

units.situation: Work: asking your manager for something

variants.study: Vorrei chiederle un giorno di ferie.
variants.phon: vor-RAY KYEH-dehr-leh oon JOR-noh dee FEH-ryeh
variants.native: I'd like to ask you for a day off.

variants.study: Vorrei chiederle un aumento.
variants.phon: vor-RAY KYEH-dehr-leh oon ow-MEHN-toh
variants.native: I'd like to ask you for a raise.

slot.study: di lavorare da casa il venerdì
slot.phon: dee lah-voh-RAH-reh dah KAH-zah eel veh-nehr-DEE
slot.native: if I can work from home on Fridays

variants.study: Vorrei chiederle di lavorare da casa il venerdì.
variants.phon: vor-RAY KYEH-dehr-leh dee lah-voh-RAH-reh dah KAH-zah eel veh-nehr-DEE
variants.native: I'd like to ask you if I can work from home on Fridays.

variants.study: Vorrei chiederle qualche giorno in più.
variants.phon: vor-RAY KYEH-dehr-leh KWAHL-keh JOR-noh een PYOO
variants.native: I'd like to ask you for a few more days.

turns.speaker: A
turns.study: Buongiorno, quanto costa questa lampada?
turns.phon: bwohn-JOR-noh, KWAHN-toh KOHS-tah KWEHS-tah LAHM-pah-dah
turns.native: Hello, how much is this lamp?

turns.speaker: B
turns.study: Sessanta euro.
turns.phon: sehs-SAHN-tah EH-oo-roh
turns.native: Sixty euros.

turns.speaker: A
turns.study: È un po' cara. Potrebbe farmi uno sconto?
turns.phon: eh oon poh KAH-rah. poh-TREHB-beh FAR-mee OO-noh SKOHN-toh
turns.native: It's a bit expensive. Could you give me a discount?

turns.speaker: B
turns.study: Mi dispiace, è già un buon prezzo.
turns.phon: mee dees-PYAH-cheh, eh JAH oon bwohn PREHT-tsoh
turns.native: I'm sorry, it's already a good price.

turns.speaker: A
turns.study: Se prendo anche questo specchio, mi fa cento per tutti e due?
turns.phon: seh PREHN-doh AHN-keh KWEHS-toh SPEHK-kyoh, mee fah CHEHN-toh pehr TOOT-tee eh DOO-eh
turns.native: If I take this mirror too, will you do a hundred for both?

turns.speaker: B
turns.study: Va bene, ma solo se paga in contanti.
turns.phon: vah BEH-neh, mah SOH-loh seh PAH-gah een kohn-TAHN-tee
turns.native: All right, but only if you pay cash.

turns.speaker: A
turns.study: D'accordo. Potrei avere una ricevuta?
turns.phon: dahk-KOR-doh. poh-TREH-ee ah-VEH-reh OO-nah ree-cheh-VOO-tah
turns.native: Deal. Could I have a receipt?

turns.speaker: B
turns.study: Certo, gliela scrivo subito.
turns.phon: CHEHR-toh, LYEH-lah SKREE-voh SOO-bee-toh
turns.native: Of course, I'll write it for you right away.

dialogues.practice: Listen to both roles, hide one role, answer, then swap one line for a variant of your own.

turns.speaker: A
turns.study: Buongiorno, signora Bianchi. Il riscaldamento non funziona da ieri.
turns.phon: bwohn-JOR-noh, see-NYOH-rah BYAHN-kee. eel rees-kahl-dah-MEHN-toh nohn foon-TSYOH-nah dah YEH-ree
turns.native: Good morning, Mrs Bianchi. The heating hasn't been working since yesterday.

turns.speaker: B
turns.study: Mi dispiace! Chiamerò il tecnico oggi stesso.
turns.phon: mee dees-PYAH-cheh. kyah-meh-ROH eel TEHK-nee-koh OHD-jee STEHS-soh
turns.native: I'm sorry! I'll call the technician today.

turns.speaker: A
turns.study: Grazie. Sarebbe possibile venire nel pomeriggio? La mattina lavoro.
turns.phon: GRAH-tsyeh. sah-REHB-beh pohs-SEE-bee-leh veh-NEE-reh nehl poh-meh-REED-joh. lah maht-TEE-nah lah-VOH-roh
turns.native: Thank you. Would it be possible to come in the afternoon? I work in the morning.

turns.speaker: B
turns.study: Glielo chiedo. Se non può oggi, verrà domani.
turns.phon: LYEH-loh KYEH-doh. seh nohn pwoh OHD-jee, vehr-RAH doh-MAH-nee
turns.native: I'll ask him. If he can't today, he'll come tomorrow.

turns.speaker: A
turns.study: Va bene. Avrei anche un'altra domanda: potrei pagare l'affitto il dieci invece del cinque?
turns.phon: vah BEH-neh. ah-VREH-ee AHN-keh oo-NAHL-trah doh-MAHN-dah. poh-TREH-ee pah-GAH-reh lahf-FEET-toh eel DYEH-chee een-VEH-cheh dehl CHEEN-kweh
turns.native: All right. I'd also have another question: could I pay the rent on the 10th instead of the 5th?

turns.speaker: B
turns.study: Va bene, ma solo se mi avvisa ogni mese.
turns.phon: vah BEH-neh, mah SOH-loh seh mee ahv-VEE-zah OH-nyee MEH-zeh
turns.native: All right, but only if you let me know every month.

turns.speaker: A
turns.study: Certo, grazie mille.
turns.phon: CHEHR-toh, GRAH-tsyeh MEEL-leh
turns.native: Of course, thank you very much.

turns.speaker: B
turns.study: Di niente. Le faccio sapere per il tecnico.
turns.phon: dee NYEHN-teh. leh FAHT-choh sah-PEH-reh pehr eel TEHK-nee-koh
turns.native: You're welcome. I'll let you know about the technician.

dialogues.practice: Listen to both roles, hide one role, answer, then swap one line for a variant of your own.

dialogues.situation: At work: asking for more time (Lei)

turns.speaker: A
turns.study: Buongiorno, dottor Conti. Avrei bisogno di parlarle del progetto.
turns.phon: bwohn-JOR-noh, doht-TOR KOHN-tee. ah-VREH-ee bee-ZOH-nyoh dee par-LAR-leh dehl proh-JEHT-toh
turns.native: Good morning, Mr Conti. I'd need to talk to you about the project.

turns.speaker: B
turns.study: Certo, mi dica.
turns.phon: CHEHR-toh, mee DEE-kah
turns.native: Of course, go ahead.

turns.speaker: A
turns.study: Sarebbe possibile avere qualche giorno in più?
turns.phon: sah-REHB-beh pohs-SEE-bee-leh ah-VEH-reh KWAHL-keh JOR-noh een PYOO
turns.native: Would it be possible to have a few more days?

turns.speaker: B
turns.study: Perché? C'è un problema?
turns.phon: pehr-KEH. cheh oon proh-BLEH-mah
turns.native: Why? Is there a problem?

turns.speaker: A
turns.study: Sì, il cliente ha cambiato idea e dobbiamo rifare una parte.
turns.phon: SEE, eel klee-EHN-teh ah kahm-BYAH-toh ee-DEH-ah eh dohb-BYAH-moh ree-FAH-reh OO-nah PAR-teh
turns.native: Yes, the client has changed their mind and we have to redo part of it.

turns.speaker: B
turns.study: Capisco. Va bene, ma solo se finite entro venerdì prossimo.
turns.phon: kah-PEES-koh. vah BEH-neh, mah SOH-loh seh fee-NEE-teh EHN-troh veh-nehr-DEE PROHS-see-moh
turns.native: I see. All right, but only if you finish by next Friday.

turns.speaker: A
turns.study: Perfetto. Se ci sono altri problemi, La avviserò subito.
turns.phon: pehr-FEHT-toh. seh chee SOH-noh AHL-tree proh-BLEH-mee, lah ahv-vee-zeh-ROH SOO-bee-toh
turns.native: Perfect. If there are any other problems, I'll let you know right away.

turns.speaker: B
turns.study: Bene. Mi mandi un aggiornamento mercoledì.
turns.phon: BEH-neh. mee MAHN-dee oon ahd-jor-nah-MEHN-toh mehr-koh-leh-DEE
turns.native: Good. Send me an update on Wednesday.

turns.speaker: A
turns.study: Certo. Grazie per la comprensione.
turns.phon: CHEHR-toh. GRAH-tsyeh pehr lah kohm-prehn-SYOH-neh
turns.native: Of course. Thank you for understanding.

dialogues.practice: Listen to both roles, hide one role, answer, then swap one line for a variant of your own.

readiness: Ask politely with the conditional (potrebbe, sarebbe possibile), set a condition (se… + future), negotiate a price or a deadline, accept on condition, decline with a reason and apologise while offering to put things right.
